description: I am a student who is interested in science, technology, space exploration, and environmental issues. I enjoy learning new things, exploring creative ideas, and developing my skills through projects. I am excited to participate in NASA Space Apps Challenge and contribute to solving real-world challenges.
summary:
Project Saturn is an interactive space exploration and survival game that allows players to experience the challenges of managing a lunar outpost. Players must maintain a functioning space base while managing essential resources such as oxygen, food and energy. The game features different facilities, including astronaut living quarters and a greenhouse for food production. Players must monitor the condition of their base and astronauts to ensure their survival in the harsh lunar environment.

Our game addresses the challenge by introducing resource management and survival elements that encourage players to make important decisions. It helps students understand the difficulties of living and working on the Moon, while learning about space exploration, sustainability and the importance of engineering in future space missions.
details:
Project Saturn Star is an interactive lunar exploration and survival game developed to simulate the experience of managing a human settlement on the Moon. Players take responsibility for maintaining a lunar base and ensuring the survival of astronauts in a challenging space environment.

The game allows players to explore and manage different facilities, including crew quarters and a greenhouse. Players must monitor important resources such as oxygen, food and energy to keep the astronauts safe and the base operational. The game focuses on survival, resource management and decision-making.

The project provides educational benefits by introducing students to space exploration, STEM concepts and the challenges of living beyond Earth. Its intended impact is to develop problem-solving skills, critical thinking and awareness of resource sustainability.

The game was developed using the Godot game engine and GDScript programming language. Our project is creative because it combines space exploration with survival and resource management in an interactive gaming experience. During development, our team considered gameplay objectives, astronaut safety, resource limitations, the lunar environment and user experience to make the game both educational and enjoyable.
